svg.title: Agent harness benchmark arena (illustration)
svg.desc: Illustration with synthetic data. An isometric arena with a crowd in the stands. A screen shows the task 'repair routing and firewall', the same for every agent. Each agent works in front of its own sealed glass box, an isolated Linux network with a client, a router, a firewall and two services, web and admin; progress bars fill at different speeds. An independent evaluator on a podium probes each network in turn, and lamps on each roof show whether web is reachable and admin is blocked. The outcomes are invented for the picture.
svg.text: ① TASK · same for every agent
